title: Inbox
body: No messages yet. Ask an office when you need help with a service or request.
annotation: Default new-account Inbox. Replace populated default; retain original example separately. No fabricated personal messages.

title: Notifications
body: You're up to date. Updates about your requests, payments, and appointments will appear here.
annotation: Default new-account Notifications. No sample notification rows or unread counts.

title: My appointments
body: No appointments yet. Find an available consultation to book your first appointment.
annotation: Owned appointment list, distinct from public office availability.

title: Office dashboard
body: No activity yet. New requests and appointment updates for your office will appear here.
annotation: Explicit zero-data office example. New staff accounts may still see valid office-wide records; do not clear those records because the account is new. Actual profile fields only.

title: Office queue
body: No requests in this view. Requests assigned to your office will appear here.
annotation: No active filters in this variant. A filtered empty variant may offer Clear filters only when a filter is actually applied.

title: Office inbox
body: No inquiries yet. Inquiries sent to your office will appear here.
annotation: No fabricated inquiry thread or outgoing message.

title: Office schedule
body: No appointments for this date. Select another date or manage your available times.
annotation: Reuse for guidance/faculty with capability-correct schedule and slot destinations. Do not expose another capability's editor.

title: Pending payments
body: No pending payments. Payments awaiting Cashiering confirmation will appear here.
annotation: Cashiering role only. No payment rows in zero-data example.

title: Payment history
body: No confirmed payments yet. Payments you are authorized to view will appear here after confirmation.
annotation: Cashiering role only. Keep original populated history as a separate example.

title: Sign-in cancelled
body: You can try again when you're ready.
annotation: Return to the originating sign-in method. A deliberate user cancellation need not be presented as an error.

title: Check your sign-in details
body: Enter your email and password to sign in.
annotation: Editable UI design. Google and email are both supported. Prototype navigation previews the next step; native validation, account creation, consent and profile completion must be enforced before dashboard access. No real account operation occurs in Figma. First-time registration only. Completed returning accounts skip registration and profile collection. Passwords remain transient and masked; reopening a valid session routes directly to the dashboard. Canonical metadata mirrors auth/sign-in-error; email/password self-registration is permitted. Forgot password resolves to the existing GoServe 2.3 auth/reset-email screen, not an older assigned-account flow. On actual sign-in failure preserve the email, keep the password masked, and do not disclose whether the account exists.

title: Complete your profile
body: Your student profile is required before you enter GoServe.

sections.text: Add your name, student ID, academic details, mobile number and gender.

annotation: Editable UI design. Google and email are both supported. Prototype navigation previews the next step; native validation, account creation, consent and profile completion must be enforced before dashboard access. No real account operation occurs in Figma. First-time registration only. Completed returning accounts skip registration and profile collection. Passwords remain transient and masked; reopening a valid session routes directly to the dashboard. Canonical metadata mirrors auth/profile-required. Complete profile resumes the existing student/consent frame, now the combined student-details form. This state is a missing-profile guard, not an email-domain restriction; completed returning accounts bypass onboarding.

title: Sign in again
body: Your session has ended. Sign in to continue.
annotation: After successful authentication restore only an authorized originating destination. Clear private content from the expired screen.

title: Access unavailable
body: You don't have permission to open this record.
annotation: Role-context variant returns staff/teller to their own queue/search. Do not show hidden reference, owner, amount, filename or preview.

title: Campus offices
body: Loading offices…
annotation: Restrained indeterminate progress; preserve actual query/filter while loading. Do not fabricate office skeleton rows or progress percent.

title: Couldn't load offices
body: Check your connection and try again.
annotation: Retry preserves query/filter. State cause only if established; use neutral network guidance rather than claiming a server outage.

title: No matching offices or services
body: Try a different name or clear your search.
annotation: Actual user query appears in the field in a live state. Clear keeps selected category; do not confuse search-empty with load failure.

title: No services listed yet
body: This office hasn't published request services here.
annotation: Contextual office name/header retained from origin. Pass the authorized office destination into inquiry. Hide New request until a configured service exists.

title: Choose a service
body: Select a published service from this office.

sections.text: The office declares whether each service requires payment.

annotation: Enrollment certificate is the existing design example, not a seeded new-account request. Populate only configured services; enable Continue after selecting one. Empty types route G03.4. Service fee choices are not student-editable.

title: Review request
body: Check your details before submitting. This service does not require payment.
annotation: Free branch skips payment choice entirely. Actual review must render entered fields/evidence, not this design explanation. On confirmed submission proceed to G04.7.

title: Review request
body: This service requires a fee. Cashiering handles the payment.

sections.title: Amount unavailable
sections.body: The office must configure the fee before you continue.

annotation: No official amount invented. Replace Not configured with server-declared amount and enable Submit only when valid configuration loads. Receipt then routes to @student/payment; student cannot supply amount.

title: Fee review pending
body: This office hasn't confirmed whether payment is required. No payment is due yet.
annotation: Conservative default: new submission disabled until pending-fee submission policy is confirmed. Existing submitted pending records remain viewable; no paid/processing claim and no unsupported Save draft.

title: Submitting request…
body: Your request is being submitted.

sections.title: Submission in progress
sections.body: Wait for confirmation before submitting again.

annotation: Async state. Root may provide design-preview success/failure navigation off canvas; no artificial live delay. Resolve to G04.7 or G04.6. Keep reviewed data and block duplicate create. No reference exists yet.

title: Request not submitted
body: Your details are still here. Try again.

sections.title: Submission failed
sections.body: No successful submission has been confirmed.

annotation: For an uncertain network result reconcile before another create attempt. Preserve originating free/required branch and validated form data.

title: Request submitted
body: The office has received your request.
annotation: Free receipt design example, isolated from zero-data default. Actual UI shows server-confirmed reference and time immediately; replace explanatory placeholders. Required-fee variant changes primary action to Choose payment method → @student/payment; preserve same confirmed receipt structure.

title: Payment declaration
body: Set the payment declaration for this office's service.

options.label: Payment required
options.detail: Enter an authorized amount; Cashiering collects payment.

annotation: Prototype editor only; actual amount field appears only when Payment required is selected. No official amount invented. Require numeric validation and review before save. Staff authority must be server-verified; effect of fee changes on existing requests unresolved. No student/teller route. Registrar and enrollment certificate are illustrative service context; actual office/service must come from the authorized configuration.

title: Saving fee declaration…
body: Your reviewed declaration is being saved.

sections.title: Reviewed change
sections.body: Keep the selected declaration and authorized amount visible while saving.

annotation: Block duplicate save and mode changes. Confirmed result uses G13.3-style read-only declaration with server actor/time; failure G05.3. No success on a local navigation alone.

title: Fee declaration wasn't saved
body: Your changes are still here.

sections.title: Save failed
sections.body: The previous declaration is still in effect.

annotation: Actual view preserves selected mode and entered amount. Cancel restores prior server value; validation errors attach to the field.

title: Cancel request
body: Tell the office why you want to cancel this request.
annotation: Prototype origin must pass affected record. Empty submit routes G06.2; nonempty submit G06.3. Staff variant title Reject request or Cancel request, back @staff/request-detail, nav Staff. Show only server-authorized transitions.

title: Cancel request
body: A reason is required before this request can be cancelled.
annotation: Focus reason field. Staff rejection/cancellation reuses validation with correct title and return target. No request transition occurs.

title: Cancel this request?
body: Review your reason before confirming.

sections.title: If this request is paid
sections.body: Payment remains recorded. Contact Cashiering for payment follow-up.

annotation: Actual confirmation shows affected reference/service and entered reason, with paid notice only on paid records. Paid confirm → G06.5. Staff Reject variant uses Reject this request? and Confirm rejection, preserving staff return. No cancellation deadline invented.

title: Request cancelled
body: This request has stopped. The cancellation reason is included in its status history.
annotation: Render terminal detail with real reason/actor/time only after confirmation; existing request-detail alias must be overridden to contextual terminal variant. Staff rejection title Request rejected; return to staff queue. Do not show Processing on destination.

title: Request cancelled
body: Payment remains recorded. Contact Cashiering about the payment.

sections.title: Payment follow-up
sections.body: Cancellation does not automatically refund or void a payment.

annotation: Contextual terminal paid-request example. Inquiry recipient preselected Cashiering. Actual detail retains paid record and cancellation reason/actor/time. Staff rejection reuses outcome with correct label. No automatic refund promise.

title: Payment confirmed
body: A confirmed payment record is available for this request.

sections.text: Request progress is tracked separately from payment.

annotation: Planned authoritative result; isolated from disabled integration. Actual result includes reference, server amount and verified source/actor/time. Receipt action appears only if a real receipt exists. Never mark Paid from browser return.

title: Payment failed
body: This payment wasn't confirmed.

sections.title: Failed payment attempt
sections.body: Your service request has a separate status.

annotation: Provider disabled; retry enabled only after server permits another attempt and payment contracts are verified. Preselect Cashiering inquiry.

title: Payment session expired
body: No payment was confirmed for this session.

sections.title: Expired
sections.body: A new payment session may be needed.

annotation: Provider disabled; start new session only after server-authorized eligibility. Do not cancel the request when a payment session expires.

title: Payment cancelled
body: No payment was confirmed for this attempt. Your request is separate from this payment attempt.

sections.title: Cancelled payment attempt
sections.body: This does not cancel your service request.

annotation: Provider disabled; payment choice enabled only when authoritative state permits another attempt.

title: Checking payment status…
body: Returning from the payment page does not confirm payment.

sections.title: Pending verification
sections.body: Wait for the latest confirmed status.

annotation: Planned async verification state. No active provider call. Real result routes to authoritative state; error G07.6; app return alone stays pending.

title: Couldn't check payment status
body: The last confirmed status hasn't changed.

sections.title: Pending verification
sections.body: No confirmed payment has been received.

annotation: Current provider-disabled variant keeps Check again inactive. Enabled future error permits safe status retry. Preserve last verified state and route inquiry to Cashiering.
